subject.title: fix(mcp): stop ignored disabled servers from starting

question: Should existing MCP configurations containing the ineffective `disabled` key fail validation until doctor or update migration repairs them?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but accepting a guided fail-closed upgrade rather than continued startup compatibility is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Accept guided migration
options.body: Land the validation and doctor/update repair while keeping runtime on the single canonical `enabled` field.

options.title: Require softer compatibility
options.body: Pause and redesign upgrade handling if legacy files must continue normal startup without explicit migration.

recommendation.title: Accept guided migration
recommendation.body: Land the validation and doctor/update repair while keeping runtime on the single canonical `enabled` field.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history most strongly connects this person to the MCP configuration and operator workflow contract.
